items.item_text: Computer experience to use Word and Excel.

Under the direction of the Assistant Athletic Director for Marketing, primary responsibility to plan, organize, and supervise the back-end operations of the Ticket Office. Manage donor and ticket holder database to ensure accurate records, processing and excellent customer service. Provide planning and supervision of students related to Campus Ticket Office service. Analyze support staff needs for individual events. Provide supervision of key events. Process athletics donations received via mail in addition to gift agreements/pledges. Coordinate donor ticket benefits with the athletics development office. Perform report generation, retrieval and manipulation. Work with the Director of ICA Information Technology (IT) and campus data security staff to ensure current processes are in accordance with Payment Card Industry (PCI) compliance requirements. Provide basic financial analysis of income and expenses. Establish policies and procedures for the Ticket Office. In addition to athletics events, the Ticket Office will handle ticketing for select student events and non-ICA events.
30% - Customer Service Representative and Onsite Events

Strong interpersonal, customer service and communication skills to interact clearly and effectively with individuals of varying backgrounds and perspectives to research, secure, and/or provide information to clarify situations and resolve problems.

Organizational and time management skills to coordinate and prioritize a variety of complex tasks in an active working environment; handle multiple deadlines and achieve timely progress on a variety of tasks and projects concurrently; prioritization skills to handle frequent interruptions and distractions and adjust to shifting priorities to maintain a high level of productivity.
Math and accounting skills to reconcile ledgers and produce accurate budgets, financial and statistical reports.
Skills to compile, analyze and interpret statistical records.
Skills to establish and adjust staffing based on individual events, client and patron needs.
Skills to identify, evaluate and improve systems and services in order to enhance internal efficiencies and client/patron satisfaction
